CollectAction
CollectAction is a concrete class which allows farmer to collect products which are produced by magic creatures.

Creature is a base class that represents the generic magic creatures that stays in the magic farm.

MagicCow
MagicCow is a class that represents the magic cows that stays in the magic farm.

MagicDuck is a class that represents the magic ducks that stays in the magic farm.
MagicFarm
MagicFarm class is a class to store all the magic creatures
MagicShark
MagicShark is a class that represents the magic sharks that stays in the magic farm.
